Description: Primary staple food grain widely cultivated across wetlands, irrigated deltas, and canal command areas.
Versatile high-yielding cereal crop cultivated for human consumption, livestock feed, and industrial processing.
Major winter season cereal grain crop grown in well-drained fertile loamy soils.
Drought-resilient coarse cereal and nutritious millet suited for semi-arid rainfed agro-ecosystems.
Pearl millet renowned for heat and drought tolerance, high iron content, and low water requirement.
Major protein-rich pulse crop (Pigeonpea / Arhar / Tur) with deep taproot and atmospheric nitrogen fixation.
Premier winter pulse crop (Chickpea / Chana) highly rich in protein and fiber, cultivated on residual moisture.
Short-duration leguminous pulse (Moong) ideal for catch-cropping, intercropping, and green manuring.
Nutrient-dense warm-season legume (Urad) critical for dietary protein, soil fertility restoration, and fodder.
